text_markup: The symbol [c] (plaintext: {curly:c}) stands for "credit". It always appears with a quantity, such as 1[c], which means "one credit," or 3[c], which means "three credits." See {ref:sec_credits} for rules about credits.
text_plain: The symbol {c} (plaintext: {c}) stands for "credit". It always appears with a quantity, such as 1{c}, which means "one credit," or 3{c}, which means "three credits." See section 1.10 for rules about credits.
